WITH w AS (SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line WHERE (channel_code='WB' OR channel_id IN (2,3)) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM w GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)) dup_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)) orphan_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0) nonpos,

 (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE net_amount IS NULL) nullnet

SELECT r.store_key, st.store_id, s.channel_code, s.channel_id, count(*) n, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net, min(r.return_date), max(r.return_date), count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) nd
FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s USING(sales_line_id) LEFT JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21' AND (st.store_id>=900 OR s.channel_code='WB' OR s.channel_id IN (2,3)) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (SELECT r.*, s.channel_code, s.channel_id, s.quantity sold_qty, s.sale_date, s.net_amount sold_net FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line s USING(sales_line_id)),
w AS (SELECT * FROM r WHERE channel_code='WB' OR channel_id IN (2,3))
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE sale_date IS NULL) returns_no_sale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM w GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) multi_return,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE quantity_returned>sold_qty) over_return,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE return_date<sale_date) before_sale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE return_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', return_ts_utc)) AS DATE)) ret_date_ne_hel,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21') ret_in_window,
 (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM w WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21') refund_in_window,
 (SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM w WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-12-21') refund_of_window_sales

WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(s.net_amount) sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line s JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = s.sale_date
  WHERE (s.channel_code = 'WB' OR s.channel_id IN (2,3)) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1,2),
web_returns AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(r.refund_net) refunds_net,
         sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id = 900 THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) refunds_at_web_shop
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE (s.channel_code = 'WB' OR s.channel_id IN (2,3)) AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_period, w.sales_net, r.refunds_net, r.refunds_at_web_shop, w.sales_net - coalesce(r.refunds_net,0) AS web_net_sales
FROM web_sales w LEFT JOIN web_returns r USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_period) ORDER BY 2
